understanding.goal: Return the poster to the colour palette it had before the warm, earthy recolour, keeping everything else as it is now.
affects: palette roles: ground, ink, accent, accent2, muted
objects coloured by those roles, including the call to action
preserves: the italic, larger headline and serif subhead
the right-aligned headline and the lit room at top right

summary: You now have the original colours back: the paper ground, ink, terracotta, ochre and muted tones from before the earthy recolour, while the expressive type and the right-leaning layout stay as they are.
